verdict.rationale: Statsig's own docs say Feature Gates toggle product behavior in real time without deploying new code, including an emergency switch that turns a code branch off for users in production. A first-feature tutorial walks through creating a gate and checking it live, and the free tier includes feature flags, so a new signup can start immediately. missing for 10: no explicit or measured time-to-first-flag claim backing 'within minutes of signing up', and no independent hands-on corroboration of how fast onboarding is.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create a feature flag and toggle it live in production within minutes of signing up

citations.quote: Feature Gates, commonly known as feature flags, allow you to toggle the behavior of your product in real time without deploying new code.
Have an emergency disable switch that lets you immediately turn off a particular code branch for users in production
This tutorial creates a feature gate, targets mobile platforms and internal testers, then checks it live with the JavaScript SDK in your browser console.
You get feature flags and 2 million metered events for free.
Get data flowing into Statsig with only a few lines of code.
